apis.purpose: Validate inputs and documents for MESSAGE FUNCTION

Trigger business action for Transfer conditions are:
Code Declaration Type Transfer Conditions
SFZ Storage in FTZ To allow the Declarant to submit Declarations for storage of non-
dutiable goods and certain dutiable goods in the FTZ
APS Approved Premises/Schemes To allow the Declarant to submit Declarations such as:
a) ME
b) Bonding of goods into a LW
c) Bonding of goods into a BW
d) CFW
e) Class II cargoes
Note: In general, any references to “LW” (or Licensed Warehouse) and
“BW” (or Bonded Warehouse) refer to licensed premises used for storing
dutiable and non-dutiable goods, respectively.
